2609.09889.title: Leveraging Fine-grained Error Correction in Korean Speech Recognition for Consultation Services
2609.09889.paper_summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology is fundamental to customer service automation and large-scale transcription. However, even advanced ASR models exhibit inevitable errors in complex real-world environments such as call center conversations. When privacy restrictions preclude audio access, error correction must rely on text-based post-editing. Existing text-only approaches face significant challenges in low-resource languages, mainly due to a critical scarcity of annotated corpora and tailored correction methodologies. For Korean, this resource gap is particularly pronounced, as existing resources are predominantly designed for ASR training rather than text-based error correction. To address this, we introduce DasanCallDial, the first large-scale Korean benchmark dataset specifically curated for dialogue-level ASR error correction. Derived from genuine call center interactions, it comprises 1,974 dialogues with 115,460 utterances. Leveraging this resource, we propose Detector-Gated Contextual Span Correction (DCSC), a text-only post-editing framework for error-sparse Korean speech recognition transcripts. DCSC combines an encoder-based detector that first performs token-level error detection, followed by a language model-based corrector trained to rectify fine-grained span-level errors. Additionally, we employ dialogue-level context augmentation to enable the model to leverage discourse history for disambiguation. By employing multi-level granularity, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively overcoming the limitations of general LLMs in low-resource settings.
2609.09889.paper_summary_zh: 自動語音識別（ASR）技術是客戶服務自動化和大規模轉錄的基礎。<lb/>然而，即使是先進的 ASR 模型在複雜的現實環境中，如呼叫中心對話，仍然會出現不可避免的錯誤。<lb/>當隱私限制阻止音頻訪問時，錯誤修正必須依賴基於文本的後編輯。<lb/>現有的僅文本方法在低資源語言中面臨重大挑戰，主要是由於註釋語料庫和量身定制的修正方法的嚴重匱乏。<lb/>對於韓語來說，這一資源差距尤為明顯，因為現有資源主要是為 ASR 訓練而設計，而非基於文本的錯誤修正。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了 DasanCallDial，這是第一個專門為對話級 ASR 錯誤修正而策劃的大規模韓語基準數據集。<lb/>該數據集源自真實的呼叫中心互動，包含 1,974 個對話和 115,460 個發言。<lb/>利用這一資源，我們提出了檢測器門控上下文範圍修正（DCSC），這是一個針對錯誤稀疏的韓語語音識別轉錄的僅文本後編輯框架。<lb/>DCSC 結合了一個基於編碼器的檢測器，首先執行標記級錯誤檢測，然後由一個基於語言模型的修正器訓練以修正細粒度的範圍級錯誤。<lb/>此外，我們還採用了對話級上下文增強，讓模型能夠利用話語歷史進行消歧。<lb/>通過採用多級粒度，我們的方法實現了最先進的性能，有效克服了在低資源環境中一般 LLM 的限制。
